title: Qubit-Based Benchmarking of InP HEMT LNAs: Readout Fidelity Versus Power Consumption
summary: High-fidelity single-shot readout of superconducting qubits is essential for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Without a quantum-limited amplifier such as a Josephson parametric amplifier, the cryogenic high-electron-mobility-transistor (HEMT) low-noise amplifier (LNA) at the 4 K stage is the dominant noise source in the readout chain. HEMT LNAs are conventionally characterized by Y-factor measurements of the noise temperature $T_N$, independently of the quantum measurement they ultimately serve.
